note: Wisdom prologue + Wisdom's call vs sinners' enticement. Role rule applied: CHARACTERISTIC = inner-being faculties/qualities/dispositions themselves (lean characteristic when in doubt). QUALIFIER = a word that STRENGTHENS/operates-with an associated characteristic in the verse — its object, manner, instrument, sphere, movement-toward, or outcome (relational, by morphology, not the word in isolation). STANDALONE = only words related to NO characteristic: proper nouns (Solomon/David/Israel/king/LORD), body parts (head/foot/neck/hand/eye), pure places/objects with no characteristic tie (Sheol/pit/street/markets/city/gates/net/garland/pendants/purse/houses), agents (son/father/mother/youth/possessors), Wisdom's bare derision (laugh/mock), and connectives/particles. Examples of the relational qualifier call: raises/voice/call/say/pour/stretched (strengthen Wisdom's active appeal = char H2451); words/proverb/saying/riddles (objects of insight/understanding); increase/obtain (growth in learning/guidance); alive/whole/blood/swallow/go-down (manner/object of the sinners' violence); goods/plunder/precious/unjust-gain/life (objects & outcome of greed H1214); run/haste/shed (movement toward evil, v16); calamity/storm/whirlwind/come (manifest/arrival of dread & distress); killed/destroys/eat/fruit/fill (outcomes on the simple & fools); dwell (dwelling in security H0983). Context-varying: H7451 = moral 'evil' v16 (characteristic) but 'disaster' outcome v33 (default standalone); H5315 here = 'life'/existence, taken as an outcome of greed -> qualifier.
